pool-state-diagnostic.title: Local runner diagnostics
pool-state-diagnostic.unavailable: This runner is unavailable. Refresh the pool list and try again.
pool-state-diagnostic.dialog_description: Inspect pool slots on the target machine and locate the original journal that needs review.
pool-state-diagnostic.state_hint: Use the runner’s original --state. For a paired runner started without --state, append .journal to the original identity file path.
pool-state-diagnostic.invalid_path: Enter a state directory path for the selected shell.
pool-state-diagnostic.copied: Command copied. Run it on the target machine.
pool-state-diagnostic.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select the command and copy it manually.
pool-state-diagnostic.paste_hint: Paste only the JSON from the overview command. The preview stays on this page.
pool-state-diagnostic.invalid_report: Unable to read the report. Paste the complete slot overview JSON.
pool-state-diagnostic.report_boundary: Source unverified. Confirm the report came from the target runner, then inspect the relevant slot.
pool-state-diagnostic.complete: All slots in the report were read.
pool-state-diagnostic.partial: The report contains a partial read.
pool-state-diagnostic.empty: The report contains no slot records.
pool-state-diagnostic.report_status.miss: The report says the pool state directory is missing.
pool-state-diagnostic.report_status.inva: The report says the pool state is invalid.
pool-state-diagnostic.report_status.unre: The report says the pool state could not be read.
pool-state-diagnostic.report_status.over: The report says the pool state exceeds the read limit.
